rows.quote: Genes that met significance thresholds were further validated in replication cohorts from the European Bioinformatics Institute (EBI) (25, 26) and the UK Biobank (26, 27), including subgroup analyses for childhood-onset and adult-onset asthma.
rows.reference_quote: Mitchell R, Elsworth BL, Raistrick CA, Paternoster L, Hemani G, Gaunt TR. MRC IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline version 2. Bristol: University of Bristol; (2019). doi: 10.5523/BRIS.PNOAT8CXO0U52P6YNFAEKEIGI
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the UK Biobank replication cohort to references 26 and 27; reference 26 is the MRC IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline version 2, whose DOI is the source identifier of one dictionary row only, and reference 27 is the general cohort description. The row is outside the listed candidates. The same sentence also attaches reference 26 to the EBI cohort.
